analyst_view.overall: Early view: Newcastle are in poor shape under Matthias Jaissle, who replaced Eddie Howe in the summer; they have lost four of five in all competitions, including back-to-back 1-0 home defeats to Everton, and reports say his job is under pressure. Ipswich lost 2-1 at home to Bournemouth last time out but beat Fulham at Portman Road in October. A change of manager at Newcastle before this game would change the picture.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals, with Newcastle expected to score 1.9. Newcastle have scored two goals in their last four league games and Jaissle admitted his side is short of belief and playing too many long balls. I lean lower.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.3 corners. Newcastle's long-ball play does not produce many sustained attacks, while Ipswich won at home against Fulham through late pressure and set pieces. Nothing clearly moves it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.4 cards. Jacob Ramsey was sent off against Everton, a sign of a frustrated Newcastle side, though his ban should be served well before December. I stay near the number until the referee is known.

shots.text: The numbers say 26 shots. Newcastle have created little lately and Jaissle called them not brave enough in possession. I lean a bit lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.5 shots on target. With Newcastle's attack misfiring and Ipswich's games against Fulham and Bournemouth fairly tight, I lean slightly lower.
